description: This file defines a static class 'Arguments' with methods for creating and manipulating named argument collections, including internal classes for handling enumerables and dictionaries of arguments and their names.

classes.name: Arguments
classes.description: A static class providing methods to create and handle named argument collections.

classes.name: Arguments.NamedEnumerable<T>
classes.description: An internal class implementing INamedEnumerable<T> for managing argument collections with associated names.

classes.name: Arguments.NamedEnumerable<T>.Named
classes.description: An internal class implementing IDictionary<string, T> to represent named arguments as key-value pairs.

methods.name: Arguments.FromT
methods.description: Creates a named enumerable from a collection of arguments and their names.

methods.name: Arguments.From
methods.description: Creates a named enumerable from a collection of objects and their names.

methods.name: Arguments.From(IDictionary<string, object>)
methods.description: Creates a named enumerable from a dictionary of string-object pairs.

methods.name: Arguments.From(IDictionary<string, string>)
methods.description: Creates a named enumerable from a dictionary of string-string pairs.

methods.name: Arguments.From(object)
methods.description: Creates a named enumerable from an object's public properties.
